podcast.body: Rami Jaffee, known as the keyboardist for Foo Fighters, was a member who cycled through The Wallflowers' lineup. "Foo Fighters keyboardist Rami Jaffee."

xref.title: Taylor Hawkins' Prog Rock Side Project (2014)
xref.body: Formed in 2014, The Birds of Satan was a side project led by Taylor Hawkins, known for its strong progressive rock leanings. The band featured fellow Foo Fighters Dave Grohl and Pat Smear, along with keyboardist Rami Jaffee, showcasing Hawkins' diverse musical interests. "In 2014, he formed a side project called The Birds of Satan, a very prog rock band that introduced itself with a 10-minute epic song entitled The Ballad of the Birds of Satan."

xref.title: The Birds of Satan (2014) - Prog Rock Side Project
xref.body: In 2014, Taylor Hawkins formed another side project called The Birds of Satan, a band with a strong prog rock sound. The group introduced itself with a 10-minute epic song titled "The Ballad of the Birds of Satan" and featured appearances from Dave Grohl, Pat Smear, and Foo Fighters keyboardist Rami Jaffee. "In 2014, he formed a side project called The Birds of Satan, a very prog rock band that introduced itself with a 10-minute epic song entitled The Ballad of the Birds of Satan."

xref.title: The Wallflowers' Consistency
xref.body: Jacob Dylan has been the sole consistent member of The Wallflowers throughout its existence, a band that remains active today. The lineup has seen several changes, with notable past members including Jack Irons, formerly of the Red Hot Chili Peppers and Pearl Jam, and Rami Jaffee, keyboardist for Foo Fighters. "Jacob has been the only consistent member of The Wallflowers over all these years, which by the way is still a going concern. People to cycle through the band have included former chili peppers and pro jam drummer Jack Irons and Foo Fighters keyboardist Rami Jaffee."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
